part_name: DZT5401 (high-voltage PNP transistor, SOT-223) - the 2N5401 / MMBT5401 die in a package that dissipates more
product_page: https://www.diodes.com/part/view/DZT5401 (returns HTTP 403 to automated clients, as recorded for the MMBT parts in L24)

obtained_from: Downloaded with curl directly from Diodes Incorporated's own host (www.diodes.com). Byte-for-byte as served. A GitHub mirror of the collection file (peteut/spice-models) was READ ONLY to learn that the DZT models existed and what they contained; nothing from it was kept or used.
license_notes: Manufacturer datasheet and manufacturer-published SPICE models, redistributed here unmodified for engineering traceability only. Copyright remains Diodes Incorporated. The collection carries the vendor's own AS-IS disclaimer.
why_this_part: ADR-068 (L56): the VAS (Q122) moves from MMBT5401 in SOT-23 (403 C/W) to the same die in SOT-223 (125 C/W on the minimum recommended pad). With every junction at its own temperature (L56, caldo.py) the VAS reached 114-122 C at 57 C air; the short-circuit case of P7 after ADR-067 put its load at 140 C against 125 C.

thermal.R_thJA_minimum_pad: 125 C/W, P_D 1 W, note 5: collector lead on the minimum recommended pad, 1 oz copper, single-sided 1.6 mm FR-4, still air
thermal.R_thJA_large_copper: 62.5 C/W, P_D 2 W, note 6: 50 x 50 mm of 1 oz copper
thermal.which_one_the_design_uses: 125 C/W. The tab is the COLLECTOR, which for the VAS is NX, the high-impedance VAS output node: a large copper area there is a stray capacitance on the dominant-pole node. Minimum pad, and the 125 C/W that goes with it.

lifecycle.status: No discontinuation marking: DS31218 Rev. 4-2 (c) 2026 contains no 'OBSOLETE', 'DISCONTINUED', 'NOT RECOMMENDED' or 'NRND' text (pdftotext + grep, L56). Same evidence class as the MMBT parts in L24, and the same honest limit: weaker than an explicit Active status string.

pinout: Pin-out top view on page 1 of the datasheet is a drawing: E, C, B along the three leads and the tab on C. Pad-number mapping to the KiCad footprint Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-223-3_TabPin2 is a layout (G2) item, as it is for every BJT in this design: the Device:Q_PNP symbol's pins are named C/B/E in the netlist, not numbered.
